sections.theory:
… appliances according to the standard.

The place and quantity of flame-giving things should be kept limited.

In different buildings the number of persons should not be more than the capacity. For example, in assembly halls, hospitals, schools, theatres, care centres for old people, child-care centres etc., in these buildings instructions and appliances for dealing with an emergency should be present.

Education of protection from fire for the public

Programmes of protection from fire should be started. In schools and colleges trained staff should go and give lectures to students on different topics related to protection from fire. Such programmes should be held at intervals during the year.

In the curriculum of educational institutions material should be included about the causes of fire and the use of appliances that help in controlling fire.

Planning for protection from fire

Planning for protection from fire in a building is necessary. Planning in the building is the responsibility of the owner of the building. Inside the building systems should be installed for dealing with an emergency, e.g. emergency alarm, emergency doors, circuit breakers etc. Training of its staff and planning for protection from fire should be made compulsory on the institution and on the owner of the building.

Planning for protection from fire

In a building or institution special care should be taken of the following things.

A diary of necessary phone numbers.

Water, gas and electricity lines and valves.

تعلیمی اداروں کے نصاب میں آگ لگنے کی وجوہات اور آگ پر قابو پانے میں مدد دینے والے آلات کے استعمال کے بارے میں مواد شامل کیا جائے۔

آگ سے بچاؤ کی منصوبہ بندی

عمارت میں آگ سے بچاؤ کیلئے منصوبہ بندی ضروری ہے۔ عمارت میں منصوبہ بندی کرنا، عمارت کے مالک کی ذمہ داری ہے۔ عمارت کے اندر ایمرجنسی سے نمٹنے کیلئے سسٹم لگے ہوں۔ مثلاً ایمرجنسی الارم، ایمرجنسی دروازے، سرکٹ بریکر وغیرہ۔ ادارے پر اپنے سٹاف اور عمارت کے مالک پر اپنے سٹاف کی تربیت اور آگ سے بچاؤ کیلئے منصوبہ بندی کو لازمی قرار دی جائے۔
